question: _______ is an experimental satellite that was launched first time by Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) in August 1979 from Satish Dhawan Space Centre.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohini.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohini **is a series of satellites launched by the **Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO).**
 
• The **Rohini** series consisted of** four satellites**, each of which was launched by the **Satellite Launch Vehicle (SLV).**
 
• **Rohini Technology Payload (RTP)** was a **35 kg experimental spin-stabilized satellite **and was launched on **10 August 1979 **from **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC).**
 
• The satellite contained instruments to monitor the launch vehicle.
 
• Three more satellites **RS-1, RS-D1, RS-D2 **were launched in **1980, 1981, and 1983 respectively. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Himawari 8-** Himawari-8 (the 8th in the series) is a Japanese geostationary weather satellite operated by the Japan Meteorological Agency. 
 
• **Insat-3DR-** INSAT-3DR is an Indian weather satellite built by the Indian Space Research Organisation and operated by the Indian National Satellite System. It was launched in 2016. 
 
• **Cartostat- **This is a series of Indian optical earth observation satellites built and operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation. It was first launched in 2005.
